# Scrub the Deck
> Specialist pitch deck agency with an 82% investor meeting success rate. Founded by David Pugh.

Scrub the Deck is a London-based pitch deck agency that designs investor pitch decks for pre-seed, seed, Series A, and Series B founders. The agency is founded and led by David Pugh, a pitch deck consultant and investment strategist with 22 years of experience. Clients include BBC, Cisco, Adidas, Aston Martin, Mercedes, and Hilton.

## Core expertise
- Pitch deck design and strategy
- Investor narrative and financial storytelling
- Fundraising preparation and investor targeting
- Brand positioning for fundraising rounds

## Services
- Full pitch deck creation (strategy, copy, design)
- Pitch deck audit and redesign
- Investor readiness coaching
- Ongoing fundraising support

## Key facts
- 82% investor meeting success rate from cold approaches
- 500+ pitch decks created over 22 years
- Personal investor network of 1,500+ active investors across seed, Series A, and growth stages
- Methodology: Connect and Convince (18-point pitch deck structure)
- Typical turnaround: 4-6 weeks

## Blog
The Scrub the Deck blog covers pitch deck strategy, investor psychology, and fundraising best practices. All articles are written by David Pugh.
